name: RealWorld-HAR
sensor_type: Accelerometer + Gyroscope from multiple wearable positions
placement: Seven on-body positions: chest, forearm, head, shin, thigh, upper arm, waist
channel_description: Seven body positions, each with 3-axis accelerometer and 3-axis gyroscope channels. Streams are aligned by timestamp and resampled to 50 Hz.

protocol.note: Use all seven body positions with accelerometer and gyroscope streams only. Align each subject/activity recording by timestamp, resample to 50 Hz, segment into 2 second windows with 50% overlap, and report mean plus standard deviation across all 15 LOSO folds.

description: The RealWorld HAR dataset contains on-body sensor recordings from 15 subjects performing 8 activities: climbing down, climbing up, jumping, lying, running, sitting, standing, and walking. This canonical track uses accelerometer and gyroscope streams from seven body positions, aligned to a common 50 Hz grid. The task is subject-independent activity recognition with Leave-One-Subject-Out evaluation.
